endpoint_device_evidence.connection_policy: No endpoint is enumerated or opened. A later session may verify the regular Launch Control 3 Custom Mode 1 port and installed topology.
endpoint_device_evidence.notes: Repository topology and synthetic messages prove transforms and edge behavior only. They do not prove endpoint identity, receipt, encoder/button feel, installed configuration, feedback, reconnect, or usability.

gesture_state_machines.state: accepted selected page 0 through 6, accepted LaneControlMode, and per-button down latch
gesture_state_machines.transition: a zero-to-positive edge for another lane selects it and preserves mode; an edge for the already-selected lane toggles Voice or Motion; duplicate positive and release produce no semantic change

gesture_state_machines.state: accepted selected page, retained LaneControlMode, CC47 down latch, and effect-clear generation
gesture_state_machines.transition: an edge from a lane selects Global without clearing; an edge while Global is accepted increments Clear exactly once; duplicate positive and release do not dispatch

gesture_state_machines.input: channel 16 CC20 through CC27 while a lane and Motion mode are accepted

gesture_state_machines.state: existing cohesion fields, BPM, Master, and ignored-global diagnostic

not_applicable_rationale: The surface has no 17th knob, fader, shift encoder, physical feedback, or hidden controller page. Explicit JUCE Voice/Motion buttons mirror the same accepted mode but are application actions rather than additional rotary controls.

semantic_bindings.binding: on a lane-button positive edge, select CC minus 40 when different from the accepted page; when equal, toggle accepted Voice or Motion mode; duplicates/releases do not dispatch
semantic_bindings.rejection: wrong channel, invalid data, CC outside 40-46, or a non-edge is rejected or accepted without musical-state dispatch according to the standard diagnostic

semantic_bindings.binding: on a CC47 positive edge select Global from a lane or increment effect-clear generation while already Global
semantic_bindings.rejection: wrong channel, invalid data, duplicate positive, or release never clears

semantic_bindings.binding: Voice CC20 maps round(value times 23 divided by 127) to Model 0 through 23
semantic_bindings.rejection: Motion or Global context cannot interpret it as Voice Model

semantic_bindings.binding: Voice CC21 maps 24 plus value times 72 divided by 127 to Pitch MIDI 24 through 96
semantic_bindings.rejection: Motion or Global context cannot interpret it as Voice Pitch

semantic_bindings.binding: Voice CC22 through CC27 map value divided by 127 to Harmonics, Timbre, Morph, Decay, Colour, and Level
semantic_bindings.rejection: Motion or Global context cannot interpret them as base Voice fields

semantic_bindings.binding: Motion CC20 maps values 0 through 63 to Trigger Off and 64 through 127 to Trigger On
semantic_bindings.rejection: Voice or Global context cannot interpret it as Trigger; there is no negative Trigger state

semantic_bindings.binding: Motion CC21 through CC27 map clamp((value minus 64) divided by 63, minus one, one) to Pitch, Model, Harmonics, Timbre, Morph, Decay, and Level Motion
semantic_bindings.rejection: Voice or Global context cannot interpret them as Motion; CC64 is exact Direct zero

semantic_bindings.binding: lane CC28 maps floor(value times 16 divided by 128) to Rate 0 through 15 in both modes
semantic_bindings.rejection: Global context uses its own bottom-row grammar

semantic_bindings.binding: lane CC29 retains value 0 through 127 as Phase in both modes
semantic_bindings.rejection: Global context uses Master on CC29

semantic_bindings.binding: lane CC30 maps floor(value times 8 divided by 128) to Shape 0 through 7 in both modes
semantic_bindings.rejection: Global CC30 is a counted no-op

semantic_bindings.binding: lane CC31 maps round(value times 16 divided by 127) to Hits 0 through 16 in both modes
semantic_bindings.rejection: Global CC31 is a counted no-op

semantic_bindings.binding: lane CC32 maps floor(value times 16 divided by 128) to Rotation 0 through 15 in both modes
semantic_bindings.rejection: Global CC32 is a counted no-op

semantic_bindings.binding: lane CC33 maps value divided by 127 to Chance in both modes
semantic_bindings.rejection: Global CC33 is a counted no-op

semantic_bindings.binding: lane CC34 maps zero to Free Repeat and positive values to 1 plus floor((value minus 1) times 64 divided by 127), clamped 1 through 64
semantic_bindings.rejection: Global CC34 is a counted no-op

semantic_bindings.binding: lane CC35 maps value divided by 127 to Depth in both modes
semantic_bindings.rejection: Global CC35 is a counted no-op

semantic_bindings.binding: Global CC20-27, CC28, CC29, and CC30-35 retain exact revision 0.4 cohesion, BPM, Master, and counted-no-op transforms
semantic_bindings.rejection: lane contexts never interpret these messages as Global values

semantic_bindings.binding: explicit JUCE Voice or Motion action sets accepted LaneControlMode without changing any musical field
semantic_bindings.rejection: the actions are disabled/hidden on Global and invalid modes sanitize to Voice
